title: Invertibility of the canonical base-localization map
statement: Let R, Rp, A, B and D be commutative rings, with the compatible algebra structures and scalar towers of [lem-pc-base-localization-map]. Suppose Rp is the localization of R at S. For every degree i, A-complex Q and base-derived tensor cohomology models L over R and K over Rp, there is a D-linear isomorphism between the D-extensions of their degree-i cohomology, whose forward map satisfies the canonical generator condition IsBaseLocalizationMap of [lem-pc-base-localization-map].

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, lemma-single-complex-base-change-condition, affine displayed localization identity; More on Algebra Tag 06Y6

proof.text: Apply B-linear cohomology invertibility and A-action compatibility, then use tensor induction and the compatible scalar towers to extend to D. The resulting isomorphism satisfies the generator equation by the D-linear glue theorem.
